Clinical Excellence & Device Safety

—

Post-market surveillance intelligence built on the embedded LATAM master plus optional regional session uploads and an embedded LATAM Problem Report. Upload new complication files anytime — the engine merges by serial, date, matching narrative and team without duplicating. Each row shows the original report, English reference, and on-demand translations (choose language).

Clinical problem surveillance currently has an authoritative embedded source for LATAM only. Procedures imported from Europe, APAC or the Middle East are excluded from safety-rate denominators until an equivalent regional clinical-event source is provided.
FILTER THE ENTIRE CLINICAL DASHBOARD
People and hospital searches create a procedure cohort. A clinical word searches the original report, English reference, issue cluster, severity and survival, then recalculates the four valve cards and Critical Cases Log. Starting a new search clears the previous valve selection.

Selected Period Safety Profile by Portfolio (Each card follows the search above; click a valve to narrow the Problem Log)

—
Permanent pacemaker/PPI rate is not calculated. The source reports do not systematically capture permanent-pacemaker follow-up. Temporary pacemakers, LBBB/BRE, AV block and post-dilatation are classified as conduction/technical findings — never as PPI. The cards therefore show documented problem cases and Documented Event-Free, not a misleading PPI percentage.

LATAM Procedural Outcomes

—

Structured Corelab follow-up for every LATAM procedure. Routine pre-/post-dilatation, balloon dimensions, final PVL and gradients are kept separate from adverse-event classification. Outcome status is derived only from documented structured evidence and never from the absence of a Problem Report.

LATAM-only qualitative registry. Worldwide procedure uploads remain available in Operations, Geo, Finance and S&OP but are not added to this clinical-outcome denominator.

Click any row for classification evidence, baseline/new PPM and translated narrative.
Case IDDateCountry / HospitalFinal Device Pre-dilatationPost-dilatationFinal PVLPost Gradient OutcomeData CoverageCorelab Narrative / Translation
Method: procedural outcome, complication resolution and event severity are independent dimensions. Unknown and legacy-unavailable records are excluded from calculated success denominators. A routine balloon use, pre-/post-dilatation or numeric gradient never creates an adverse event.
EOA availability: EOA was not systematically collected because it requires dedicated post-procedural echocardiographic acquisition/assessment and was not part of a funded standardized Corelab protocol.

Reports & Case Timeline

—

Local LATAM document intelligence for 3mensio planning, procedure outcomes, Clinical Excellence reports and Engineering / HQ reviews. The app stores a private metadata index and opens the original SharePoint document only when requested.

🕰️

No report intelligence available for 2025

The private Reports & Case Timeline registry begins in 2026. Enable 2026 in Time Travel to restore report cards, imports, links and timelines.

One case, independent evidence. Planning recommendation, implanted valve, procedure comment, problem report and engineering review remain separate events in the same timeline. Local registry loading…
Private local mode. Patient names are used only in memory to calculate a one-way match token and are then discarded. PDFs are not embedded in this HTML. SharePoint links stay in this browser’s private registry, may contain a patient filename, and are excluded from Nikki / HQ Excel and PDF exports.

1. Read planning or engineering reports

Select one or many PDFs. Text is extracted locally with PDF.js; OCR runs only when a usable text layer is unavailable. Every proposed link is reviewed before it is saved.

No PDF batch selected.

2. Add the SharePoint tracking links

Import a static Microsoft Lists export (.xlsx, .xls, .csv or .tsv). The app matches by report number and private patient token. An .iqy connection file is not a static workbook and is intentionally rejected. Opening an original uses the Microsoft session already active in the browser; this app never requests or stores a SharePoint password.
